title: Remove rectangle element above tagline in Navbar header

requirements.summary: Remove the rectangle element (div, image, banner, or decorative block) that appears above the tagline 'Especialistas en Ciberseguridad · Reynosa, Tamaulipas' in the Navbar header
acceptanceCriteria: The rectangle element no longer appears above the 'Especialistas en Ciberseguridad · Reynosa, Tamaulipas' text in the header.
The rest of the Navbar layout and content remains intact.
No visual gaps or broken layout are introduced where the rectangle was.

file_operations.description: Remove the rectangle element (div, image, banner, or decorative block) that is positioned above the tagline text 'Especialistas en Ciberseguridad · Reynosa, Tamaulipas'. Identify the element by examining the JSX structure in the header/brand area and remove only the decorative rectangle while preserving the tagline text and surrounding layout.
